payload.answer: Old plugin shows red, Judge outage shows red, Known issue reaches sessions, Study from records, Don't forget you offloaded some of it to another session. Make sure that you dispatch these answers accordingly. Known issues topic: it should also be gated on whether the plugin is up-to-date of course.

options.description: After landing, in a session running an older plumb build, the band shows the red 'older than main' line; after a reload it's gone.
options.label: Old plugin shows red

options.description: With the judge's key removed or the network cut, the band shows red with the exact cause; once it's back, the line clears.
options.label: Judge outage shows red

options.description: A known issue (e.g. the question-tool answers one) is announced in a fresh session, and reproducing its symptom reopens the old case and says it came back.
options.label: Known issue reaches sessions

options.description: A requested study names the records it draws on; changing one marks the study out of date and the band offers a refresh.
options.label: Study from records

payload.question: How will you see all this working?
